notes: Original drills. Key order matches public typing.com Beginner + Intermediate titles. No copied lesson text, videos, or assets.

lessons.title: How to Sit and Place Your Hands
lessons.intro: Learn how to sit and where each finger lives before you type.

screens.title: Sit like a typer
screens.body: Feet flat on the floor. Back straight, not stiff. Screen at eye level. Elbows near your sides. Wrists float — do not rest them on the desk while you type.
screens.tts: Feet flat on the floor. Back straight. Screen at eye level. Elbows by your sides. Wrists float.

screens.title: Home row bumps
screens.body: Feel the little bumps on F and J. Left index finger on F. Right index finger on J. Those bumps tell your hands they are home.
screens.tts: Feel the bumps on F and J. Left index on F. Right index on J.

screens.title: Left hand home
screens.body: Left pinky A. Left ring S. Left middle D. Left index F. Left index also reaches G. Thumbs rest on the space bar.
screens.tts: Left hand. Pinky A, ring S, middle D, index F. Thumbs on space.

screens.title: Right hand home
screens.body: Right index J. Right middle K. Right ring L. Right pinky semicolon. Right index also reaches H. Always return home after each letter.
screens.tts: Right hand. Index J, middle K, ring L, pinky semicolon. Always come home.
